complexDefinition.stringValue: A particular portion of space, whether of definite or indefinite extent.

definition.stringValue: A specific area or spot.

text.stringValue: Конкретная область или место.
**Place** your cup on the coaster.
He found a quiet **place** to read.
This is the **place** where we first met.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The position or site occupied or to be occupied by a building or town.

definition.stringValue: The spot where a building or town is situated.

text.stringValue: Место, где расположено здание или город.
**Place** your house on that vacant lot.
San Francisco is a wonderful **place** to live.
The **place** where our school is located is very strategic.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A portion or area of space.

definition.stringValue: A part of space.

text.stringValue: Часть пространства.
**Place** the sculpture in this spot.
I left my bag in that **place**.
There's a special **place** in my heart for you.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An open space, especially one in a city, prepared for a particular purpose.

definition.stringValue: An open area in a city made for a specific use.

text.stringValue: Открытая территория в городе, предназначенная для определенного использования.
**Place** de la Concorde is a historic square in Paris.
The Central Park is a green **place** in New York City.
The city built a new **place** for outdoor concerts.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A printed form or document.

definition.stringValue: A printed document or form.

text.stringValue: Отпечатанный документ или форма.
**Place** was sent for signature approval.
Your insurance **place** is missing an important detail.
I received the new employment **place** today.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A point made in an argument.

definition.stringValue: A point made in a debate.

text.stringValue: Высказанная в дебатах точка зрения.
**Place** your argument within the historical context.
Her essay made a convincing **place** against corporal punishment.
He lost his **place** in the heated immigration debate.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A building or spot where something particular happens.

definition.stringValue: A spot where specific events happen.

text.stringValue: Место, где происходят определенные события.
**Place** your bet, this is where the race starts.
He found the secret **place** where they kept the treasure.
The market is usually a busy **place** during weekends.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To put in a particular position or location.

definition.stringValue: To put somewhere.

text.stringValue: Положить куда-то.
**Place** your shoes by the door.
**Place** the dishes in the cupboard.
**Place** the letters on the desk.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To find accommodation or employment for.

definition.stringValue: To provide with a job or home.

text.stringValue: Обеспечивать работой или жильем.
**Place** him in the engineering department.
They managed to **place** all the kittens in loving homes.
The agency will **place** her in a foster family.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To arrange or classify.

definition.stringValue: To sort or arrange.

text.stringValue: Сортировать или организовывать.
**Place** these books on the shelf alphabetically.
She carefully **placed** the photos in chronological order.
Remember to **place** the numbers in descending order.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To appoint to a suitable position or post.

definition.stringValue: To assign to a fitting job or role.

text.stringValue: Назначить на подходящую работу или роль.
*The company **placed** me in the marketing department.*
*They **placed** her as the head of customer service.*
*He was **placed** in charge of the entire project.*

complexDefinition.stringValue: To fix or establish as in an office.

definition.stringValue: To establish in a role.

text.stringValue: Установить в роли.
**Place** him as the lead actor in our upcoming play.
The coach decided to **place** her as the team's captain.
They would **place** me front and center in all negotiations.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To submit (a proposal, resolution, etc.) for consideration.

definition.stringValue: To present for consideration.

text.stringValue: Представить для рассмотрения.
**Place** your thoughts openly on today's meeting agenda.
We agreed to **place** these ideas into the report.
The professor asked us to **place** our homework on his desk.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To invest (capital) in a promising venture or enterprise.

definition.stringValue: To invest money in a business.

text.stringValue: Инвестировать деньги в бизнес.
**Place** your savings into a promising startup.
He decided to **place** a large sum in real estate.
I will **place** my inheritance in a tech company.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To identify or regard as being in a specified relation to something else.

definition.stringValue: To see as being related to something else.

text.stringValue: Видеть как связанное с чем-то другим.
**Place** his success within the context of natural talent.
**Place** her anger in relation to childhood trauma.
We must **place** this story within its historical context.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To recognize and respect (someone's rights, wishes, etc.).

definition.stringValue: To acknowledge someone's rights or wishes.

text.stringValue: Признавать чьи-либо права или желания.
**Place** importance on her choice of university.
They always **place** respect on cultural traditions during meetings.
We must **place** emphasis on students' mental health concerns.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To conclude a contract or agreement for.

definition.stringValue: To make an agreement.

text.stringValue: Заключить соглашение.
**Place** the order if the terms are agreeable.
They **place** confidence in their negotiations.
Make sure to **place** an emphasis on clear communication.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To make a bet of (something).

definition.stringValue: To bet something.

text.stringValue: Сделать ставку на что-то.
**Place** your bet on your favorite team.
I decided to **place** a bet on the horse race.
She **place**d all her savings on black.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause to be in a specified state or condition.

definition.stringValue: To make be in a certain state or condition.

text.stringValue: Приводить в определенное состояние или условие.
**Place** the vase instinctively at the center of the table.
He **placed** his trust invariably in his childhood friend.
Her comment **placed** me in an uncomfortable situation.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To sing a musical item with precision and correctness.

definition.stringValue: To correctly perform a musical piece.

text.stringValue: Правильно исполнить музыкальное произведение.
**Place** each note with precision and emotion during the recital.
She can **place** Beethoven's 5th Symphony perfectly on her violin.
He meticulously **place**s every chord in the jazz composition.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To finish in a specified position in a race or competition.

definition.stringValue: To end a race or competition in a certain spot.

text.stringValue: Закончить гонку или соревнование в определенном месте.
**Placed** third, she proudly accepted her bronze medal.
With strength and determination, John **placed** second in marathon.
The rookie surprisingly **placed** first in the swimming competition.
